document_type: OpenState product reference for AI tools and search agents
reference_status: Review-branch documentation; verify deployment and checkout against the actual published release before public promotion.

product.name: OpenState
product.short_description: Structural code search/read/edit tools plus persistent, provenance-backed project state.
product.intended_audience: Software developers using coding agents, especially on multi-session repositories.
product.deployment: Local on developer machines; no hosted project-state service.
product.license_model: Proprietary Rust engine, with separately MIT-licensed public integration surfaces.
not_for: Hosted team memory or cross-machine synchronization
Perfect capture of every event or model reasoning

what_it_does.details: 22 operations: 8 discovery/reader tools and 7 editing families each split into preview and apply. Source-aware guards refuse stale previews; edit identities are single-use. Some operations are lexical/AST based, not type-resolved.
what_it_does.implementation: ast-grep based structural core; Rust engine authorizes and commits writes.

what_it_does.details: 14 tools inspect, trace, export and maintain locally derived session state: decisions, failed or completed commands, active files, objectives and blockers. The capsule condenses current facts for continuation.
what_it_does.capture_scope: Only supported observed events and accessible saved-host sessions, not every external terminal command or model internal reasoning.

privacy.stored_locally: State, session-derived facts, project messages and command paths may be stored locally; treat like development/shell history.
privacy.outbound_service_calls: GitHub for installer release downloads; Keygen and OpenState license worker for license checks/free apply counting; other host history APIs can be contacted if configured.
privacy.license_fields: License key, machine fingerprint hash, platform name; no project source files sent as part of license checks.
privacy.telemetry_claim: No separate product telemetry is asserted, but license and installer network requests still occur.

tools.name: openstate_diagnostics
tools.description: Run the repository-declared Rust cargo check for one file. A Cargo.toml at the repo root is the workspace. When the root has none, the nearest Cargo.toml above the file is that standalone crate. Execution is bounded; status is success, error, timeout, or unavailable.

tools.name: openstate_ast_search
tools.description: Call FIRST to locate code or text: use query_kind=text for literal Markdown/prose search, otherwise search for a definition or identifier. Hits are always in matches. match_count is the total; when truncated is true, matches is a bounded sample and matches_shown is its length. There is no entries list. A text result also returns query, scope_resolved, files_scanned, files_skipped_binary, and scan_complete, including when match_count is 0. Every code edit in this repo starts here: openstate_ast_search -> preview -> apply.

tools.name: openstate_read_symbol
tools.description: Read one complete AST symbol body from one exact source file. This is the reader after symbol discovery; it is bounded and never a raw file dump. A body over the payload is paged: pass next_cursor back unchanged until it is null.

tools.name: openstate_read_text_region
tools.description: Read a bounded source region around one unique literal anchor. The window is 3 lines before the anchor and the lines argument after it (default 4, maximum 400), cut to the payload limit; a cut sets cut_at_line and the last returned line is the next anchor. lines and occurrence accept a number or a numeric string. Pass lines 200 to read a whole file. Use for prose, configuration, and text-fallback formats. This is not a byte-offset reader and it does not read a git revision.

tools.name: openstate_find_referencing_symbols
tools.description: Find symbol declarations and lexical AST token references across repository scope, in any language with a symbol profile. Rust includes receiver.method() and field names (field_identifier). This is not type-resolved semantic analysis.

tools.name: openstate_symbol_overview
tools.description: List symbols in repository scope using ast-grep, in any language with a symbol profile. Returns stable identities, file/range, kind, visibility, and declaration context.

tools.name: openstate_find_declaration
tools.description: Find a symbol declaration by name using ast-grep, in any language with a symbol profile. Refuses unsupported languages and no-match queries deterministically.

tools.name: openstate_find_implementations
tools.description: Find Rust impl blocks for a type or trait using ast-grep. This is lexical AST navigation, not type-resolved analysis.

tools.name: openstate_rename_symbol_preview
tools.description: Second step of the edit chain (after openstate_ast_search): get a durable rename preview ID for an identifier. Returns match_count and an identity to pass to openstate_rename_symbol_apply. Always preview before applying; do not provide ast-grep syntax.

tools.name: openstate_rename_symbol_apply
tools.description: Final step: apply a rename from a preview identity (from openstate_rename_symbol_preview). Single-use: a second apply of the same identity returns already_consumed — run a new preview. Refuses stale files, wrong session, missing preview.

tools.name: openstate_delete_symbol_preview
tools.description: Edit-chain step 2 (after openstate_ast_search): get a durable delete preview for a named function or type by its AST boundary. Returns an identity for openstate_delete_symbol_apply. Single-use.

tools.name: openstate_delete_symbol_apply
tools.description: Final step: delete a symbol from a preview identity (openstate_delete_symbol_preview). Single-use; refuses missing/stale/ambiguous/cross-session previews.

tools.name: openstate_move_symbol_preview
tools.description: Edit-chain step 2 (after openstate_ast_search): get a durable move preview. Moves a named function or type from one scope/file to a destination anchor (before/after). Returns identity + source/dest spans for openstate_move_symbol_apply. Single-use.

tools.name: openstate_move_symbol_apply
tools.description: Final step: move a symbol from a preview identity (openstate_move_symbol_preview). Single-use; refuses stale (source or dest), missing, or cross-session previews. Writes both files.

tools.name: openstate_edit_symbol_preview
tools.description: Edit-chain step 2 (after openstate_ast_search): get a durable symbol-edit preview. mode=rename renames the symbol (identifier tokens); mode=replace replaces the WHOLE definition/body with the provided new definition. Returns identity + span for openstate_edit_symbol_apply. Single-use. This is the primary edit tool for code — find the symbol, then replace it in one operation.

tools.name: openstate_edit_symbol_apply
tools.description: Final step: apply a symbol edit from a preview identity (openstate_edit_symbol_preview). Single-use; refuses stale/missing/cross-session previews. Prefers structural (never splits a brace); mode=rename uses identifier rewrite, mode=replace swaps the whole definition span.

tools.name: openstate_insert_symbol_preview
tools.description: Edit-chain step 2 (after openstate_ast_search): get a durable insertion preview. Locates a named function, returns its AST boundary + an identity for openstate_insert_symbol_apply. The snippet must be one function in the target language; a preview ID is single-use. Never provide ast-grep syntax.

tools.name: openstate_insert_symbol_apply
tools.description: Final step: apply an insertion from a preview identity (openstate_insert_symbol_preview). Single-use; run a fresh preview to re-insert. Rejects missing, stale, ambiguous, or cross-session previews.

tools.name: openstate_edit_text_preview
tools.description: Edit-chain step 2 (after locating the text): get a durable preview that replaces an anchor string in ANY text file (Markdown/JSONC/TOML/config). Returns an identity + planned before/after for openstate_edit_text_apply. Single-use. The anchor must appear once, or pass occurrence (1-based) to choose one match — the same index read_text_region uses. That choice is stored on the preview and checked again on apply. Ambiguous refusals list each match with its occurrence, offset, context, and line-ending flags, and no_match carries the nearest candidate so you never need shell probes.

tools.name: openstate_edit_text_apply
tools.description: Final step: apply an anchor replacement from a preview identity (openstate_edit_text_preview). Single-use; refuses missing/stale/ambiguous-now/cross-session previews.

tools.name: openstate_create_file_preview
tools.description: Create a new file primitive: preview a durable create for a repository-relative path that does not yet exist. Returns an identity for openstate_create_file_apply. Single-use; refuses existing targets. Prefer this over shell redirection when the write tool is disabled.

tools.name: openstate_create_file_apply
tools.description: Final step: create the file from an openstate_create_file_preview identity. Single-use; refuses missing/stale/cross-session previews and existing targets.

tools.name: openstate_capsule
tools.description: Read a compact current-project resume summary: objective, decisions, blockers, recent work and next actions.

tools.name: openstate_state
tools.description: Inspect the currently retained project facts, including active, completed and failed work.

tools.name: openstate_report
tools.description: Inspect failures, blockers and unresolved work.

tools.name: openstate_report_timeline
tools.description: Read project facts and outcomes arranged by source session.

tools.name: openstate_why
tools.description: Trace a fact back to its supporting source and provenance.

tools.name: openstate_close
tools.description: Close or correct a retained fact, with a reason.

tools.name: openstate_sessions
tools.description: List supported host sessions discovered for the current project.

tools.name: openstate_assess
tools.description: Replay an identified supported saved session into project state, with idempotent record handling.

tools.name: openstate_checkpoint
tools.description: Persist the current state to disk.

tools.name: openstate_export
tools.description: Export state and capsule in JSON form.

tools.name: openstate_reset
tools.description: Clear state only after recoverability checks; potentially destructive.

tools.name: openstate_restart
tools.description: Checkpoint and verify state can reload in a fresh engine.

tools.name: openstate_doctor
tools.description: Report local engine and store health.

tools.name: openstate_toast
tools.description: Control OpenCode completion toast preference.

limitations_and_no_claims: No measured general reduction in repeated agent failures.
No promise that the agent always follows a capsule or never repeats mistakes.
No promise of universal cross-host automatic transcript capture.
No true semantic/type-resolved rename guarantee: lexical AST matching has limitations.
No controlled causal claim that installing OpenState lowers API bills.
AI crawlers are not guaranteed to ingest llms.txt or this JSON reference.
